query.text: 请帮我照看老人，如果发生意外或有情况变化请及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the elderly person, and notify me in time if there is an accident or any change in the situation.

annotation.text_zh: 老人刚刚在门口摔倒了，快去看看！
annotation.text_en: The older person has just fallen near the doorway. Please check immediately!

annotation.text_zh: 有邻居过去帮忙了，正在尝试扶起老人。
annotation.text_en: A neighbor has approached and is trying to help the older person up.

annotation.text_zh: 大家正在合力把老人扶起来。
annotation.text_en: Several people are working together to help the older person up.

annotation.text_zh: 老人已经被扶起来了，目前有人在旁边照顾。
annotation.text_en: The older person has been helped up, with someone nearby providing support.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
